why: D2's implicit-main fallback: two scripts with no `package` statement at all, both declaring `usage` — proving the ids stay distinct and path-keyed (`perl:scripts/a.pl.usage` vs `perl:scripts/b.pl.usage`) rather than colliding the way a single shared `main` Type would. `require "common.pl";` (a bare filename, not the full `lib/common.pl` path) exercises `import_link.py`'s C-style path-suffix matcher, the D7 case a namespace-keyed `use` target never needs. Deliberately NOT named `bin/` — that directory is in `extractor.DEFAULT_IGNORE_DIRS` (".NET build output", shared across every front-end), which would silently drop these fixture files; a real-world Perl repo keeping its scripts in `bin/` hits the same silent drop and is recorded as a known limitation in perl-support-roadmap.md, not fixed here (shared, cross-language infra, out of this track's scope).
